rationale: The materiality-indicator × centered-rank structure is a legitimate reuse of the archive's best-performing template applied to a genuinely new variable, but note the ranked quantity (operating cash flow per dollar of cumulative R&D) mechanically favors the *least* R&D-intensive firms within the material group and is heavily loaded on plain profitability, so it may test the opposite tilt from the "research franchise" story in the hypothesis.

target_name: Worst-Year Total Liquidity Floor on Research
rationale: This is a mechanical merge of the two archived quality legs into one term that sums an annual flow (oancf) with a balance-sheet stock (act−lct) in incompatible units, and since net working capital is typically much larger it will be dominated by the already-tested working-capital version rather than constituting a distinct economic construct.

The organic-versus-acquired intangible contrast is a genuinely new leg and the quality leg is held fixed for a clean one-change comparison, though the netted variable mixes two incompatible measurement bases (expensed cumulative R&D vs. deal-priced book intangibles) and risks being a repackaged bundle of the known R&D-to-assets and goodwill/acquisitiveness anomalies.

Internally inconsistent — the R&D-change leg is an uncentered IND_RANK in [0,1], so the score's sign is determined entirely by the cash-flow rank and firms with no research-intensity change do *not* sit near zero as the reasoning claims, leaving a signal that is mostly a profitability sort scaled by ramp rank, with a huge tie mass at zero change for non-reporters.

Economically well-motivated but this is the fourth instance of the same MIN(R&D-intensity, worst-year-profitability-floor) template in the archive (Weakest-Link, Margin Floor, Hidden Gap), so the R&D add-back and capitalized denominator amount to a cosmetic re-specification of an already-explored design rather than a substantively different mechanism.

Conditioning the drawdown construct on booked-intangible heaviness is a new and coherent subpopulation restriction with a clear impairment-cliff mechanism and a two-sided, well-labeled spread, though the drawdown leg is close to a profitability-deterioration proxy and the diagnostic value hinges on the 20% threshold not shrinking the effective sample too far.
